title: MIDNIGHT SPIRIT
SEEKING HIS PRESENCE
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: silhouette of ancient stone watchtower at night
deep starry night sky over mountain range
flickering oil lamp light in dark sanctuary
serene blue moonlight over a silent forest
distant horizon at night with soft glow
prayer vigil light on dark wooden altar

scenes.a: That relentless weight of worry pressing against your chest is fading as you seek light.
With my soul have I desired thee in the night;
yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early:
for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
Lord, anchor this weary heart in your sovereign truth during these quiet, shadowed hours of waiting.
Grant clarity where there is confusion and bring peace that surpasses human understanding to this soul.
